hypotheses.claim: A source-grounded pipeline improves independently adjudicated source-facet fidelity on unseen natural source-family/time groups.
hypotheses.narrowing_rule: Without independent labels and measured controls, retain only method description; teacher loss cannot support this claim.
hypotheses.rationale: Independently adjudicated source-facet fidelity was not collected. Final-test 1913 units remain no_run. Teacher/prover/reconstruction scores are not this claim.

hypotheses.claim: Checked bridges and bounded learned advice improve useful native-checker proof coverage without increased false transfer.
hypotheses.narrowing_rule: Solver-local or fixture outcomes cannot establish native proof coverage; unavailable proof routes remove this claim only.
hypotheses.rationale: Native-checked useful-proof coverage on natural held-out sources is unavailable. Constructed Q1 transfer and solver-local encodings are not this claim. Zero observed false transfers on a finite constructed set is not universal soundness.

hypotheses.claim: Shared learning generalizes beyond sample memory.
hypotheses.narrowing_rule: T1 is a memorization diagnostic; no final-test/trained-checkpoint evidence means no gain claim.
hypotheses.rationale: No held-out all-facet fidelity exists. Actual AF-029 T2 completed all three seeds. AF-029 packed_cpu updates are measured train/selection execution and do not support unseen source-family generalization.

hypotheses.claim: Isolated trusted proof feedback improves routing/calibration without harming source fidelity.
hypotheses.narrowing_rule: A predictive head or checker-derived target without isolated update/checker evidence does not support this claim.
hypotheses.rationale: Actual AF-029 T3 applied 256 compiler-structural feedback updates per seed. Earlier AF-012 isolation probes remain constructed history. Protected parameters were preserved, but source fidelity remains unmeasured.

hypotheses.claim: Promoted guidance improves a real compiler/realizer consumer on unseen material.
hypotheses.narrowing_rule: An export or canary-only result without load receipt and locked-test evaluation does not support deployment improvement.
hypotheses.rationale: AF-013 reports T4 unactivated/unavailable with e_locked. Export identity is not applied learned guidance. Independent source fidelity is unmeasured.

hypotheses.claim: A bounded executable repair improves a sealed starting arm without test-selected patches.
hypotheses.narrowing_rule: A proposed or unexecuted patch is methods evidence only and does not complete T5.
hypotheses.rationale: AF-014 records T5-NO-MEASURED-IMPROVEMENT as no_run. The accepted exception-scoping compiler contract on constructed witnesses is not held-out fidelity or native coverage.

hypotheses.claim: Retrieval, premise selection, planning, and proof assistance have separable matched-budget utility.
hypotheses.narrowing_rule: Proxy labels, hand-authored selector weights, or declared-only routes stay qualified and cannot support utility claims.
hypotheses.rationale: AF-017/AF-018 provide constructed automatic-label/structural diagnostics only. Natural Table 13 cells remain unrun/unavailable. Hand-authored weights and proxy labels are disclosed; they were not represented as prespecified natural utility results.

hypotheses.claim: Apparent T1 gain on seen sources is a sample-memory diagnostic rather than unseen generalization.
hypotheses.narrowing_rule: T1 is a memorization diagnostic; teacher cosine is not source-facet fidelity.

This supports the prespecified memorization diagnostic only. It does not fill Table 11 held-out fidelity and is claim_admissible=false.

hypotheses.claim: Shared-parameter learning generalizes to unseen source-family/time groups.
hypotheses.narrowing_rule: Actual trained checkpoints do not substitute for unperformed final-test source-fidelity measurement.
